capabilities: watch the app, insider (Catalyst) and installer release streams
show outdated streams in a status bar item with an installed-versus-published panel
announce each new version once with a changelog link
warn when the bundled Electron is below Obsidian's minimum version
check for updates on demand via a command
disambiguation: Not a plugin update tracker; it only watches Obsidian app, insider and installer releases, never community plugin updates.
extras: Documentation is a plain-markdown demo vault (also downloadable from Releases) with buttons that run real checks; each check makes four requests including one against GitHub's API, so hourly checks use one of GitHub's sixty per-hour requests. Beta versions install via BRAT.
intentEvidence: Turning off Obsidian's automatic updates also turns off its checking, so from then on nothing tells you a release happened
motivation: The author built it because turning off auto-update leaves no notice of new releases, and nothing in the interface connects an old installer's Electron version to features being withheld.
problem: Disabling Obsidian's automatic updates also disables its release checking, and the installer version that carries Electron is never checked at all, so users silently miss releases and gated features.
summary: Update watcher that reports new Obsidian app, Catalyst insider and installer releases in the status bar with changelog links, without installing anything.
